description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and operational excellence. Join a team committed to fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and success of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards and driving continuous improvement in quality of care and resident satisfaction. This pivotal role offers the chance to make a significant impact on the lives of residents and the professional growth of your team.This full-time position offers a competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000, reflecting your expertise and contributions. We are looking for a leader ready to embrace this challenging yet rewarding role.
requirements: Active Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Strong leadership and operational management skills
In-depth knowledge of state and federal regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description: We are urgently seeking a dedicated and compassionate Registered Nurse (RN) to join the team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Red Bay, AL. This vital full-time role involves working 12-hour shifts, providing exceptional patient care during the evening and night hours. We are looking for a professional who is ready to make an immediate impact.As an RN, you will be responsible for administering medications, performing treatments, and monitoring patient conditions, ensuring the highest standards of care are met. Your expertise will be crucial in maintaining patient well-being and contributing to a supportive and healing environment.This is an urgent opening, and we are looking for candidates who can start promptly. If you are a skilled RN seeking a challenging yet rewarding opportunity with consistent 12-hour shifts, we encourage you to apply today.
requirements: Current and active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Alabama.
Minimum of 1 year of experience in a skilled nursing facility or similar healthcare setting.
Ability to work 12-hour evening/night shifts, including weekends as needed.
Demonstrated strong clinical assessment, critical thinking, and communication skills.
